purpose: Teach: 宗派/聖霊/自明/恒久/不平等/伝導/消失/垣間見

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、仏教宗派の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you handled a comparative study of Buddhist sects in your paper, Ren.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Gentle confirmation — not testing, noting. Interested in what he's done. Steady eye contact, teacher-to-student but genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、キリスト教の聖霊論の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually wrote my paper on the pneumatology of Christian theology.
lines.style: Quick, slightly self-correcting energy. A hint of nervousness under the earnestness — he's about to reveal something different from what she said. Not defensive, just wanting her to understand.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、数学の自明な定理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I noticed you wrote about self-evident theorems in mathematics, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle redirection — she's figured something out. Not accusatory, curious. Soft cadence, like she's thinking aloud with him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、平和の恒久化政策研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually my paper was on sustainable peace-building policies.
lines.style: Small, honest admission. He's not frustrated — he's accepting that she sees something. Quieter than before, letting the words land without defend.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の不平等構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You've engaged with structural inequality in society through your research, I think.
lines.style: Slight sharpening in her tone — not unkind, but more direct now. She's naming a pattern. Engaged but not judgmental. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、半導体の伝導率研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined conductivity in semiconductors.
lines.style: Quieter resignation. He's aware now of the disconnect she's pointing at. Still earnest, but smaller — not withdrawn, just... accepting the observation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、絶滅言語の消失過程を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the extinction process of endangered languages — that was your focus, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle but clear. She's laid out the pattern openly now. Not accusing, just reflecting back what she's observed. Steady, maternal concern underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、患者の心に垣間見える希望の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I wrote about glimpses of hope I saw in my patients' hearts.
lines.style: Sudden softness and honesty. The real answer surfaces. Quiet, genuine, no performance. A release — like he's finally said the true thing underneath all the others.
